comment.body:
Thanks for the screenshot. It shows Alt (Left)+Tab as the source shortcut, but no target shortcut is visible. The description says this should crouch or open inventory in a game, while Alt+Tab normally switches applications. Could you please:
1. Retest on PowerToys 0.100.2 or newer and name the game and keyboard/input mode.
2. Give numbered steps and the exact source and target shortcuts configured in the Select and To send columns.
3. With the remap disabled, say whether the intended game action works when you press the target chord directly.
That will distinguish an incomplete remap from a game-specific input or Windows task-switcher conflict.
